cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You were very serious about my washing up while you were winning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.

mechanism: A enforces a chess washing-up consequence while taking drying and setting up the rematch to keep B cooperative.
confusable: Unlike simply asking for household help, A ties B duty to the lost-game agreement and keeps it ahead of the rematch.
comparison: Dishes and another chess game differ from a budget presenter getting speech-writing support.
seedUse: D197-a lost chess and rematch; S02-a shares adjacent work without absorbing B penalty.
